summary: A working leakage-free balanced clustered-retrieval simulator consumed the exact tied embedding and exposed a degenerate one-unique-row capture. Two deterministic diverse structural proxies falsified the static centroid route: no 32-D or 128-D geometry met top-1/top-10 recall while beating the ideal grouped-exact H200 floor.
next_action: Do not claim a GPU for this static index. Capture one unseen 384-row target-verification step with proposed draft IDs, dense top-10, request/depth mapping, and accepted-prefix decisions only when an existing admitted endpoint can emit it. Resume architecture work only with a learned or frequency-aware router that clears 31/32 top-1 and 90% top-10 offline below the 1093.817 us grouped-exact floor.

typed_boundary.exact_need: 384 post-final-norm BF16 hidden rows, 384 proposed draft token IDs, dense top-10 IDs/values, request/depth mapping, and dense accepted-prefix decisions from one unseen target-verification step
typed_boundary.effect: Synthetic results can close this static realization but cannot establish production recall, accepted-prefix fidelity, model quality, or sampling support.
